The focus-scoped tail already surfaced the core narrative (Narrative_DefaultRefTopicBranch), the sample, the observation, and style observations — all directly about this document. I expanded Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint because it names context preservation as the next sprint priority, which this default-ref test directly exercises. I did not expand the pricing or Zephyr integration positions as they bear no relation to a default-ref test.
